text.lead: Zero Bridge is a 2008 Kashmiri drama film written and directed by Tariq Tapa, starring Mohamad Imran Tapa, Taniya Khan and Ali Mohammad Dar. It is Tapa's feature directorial debut.
text.cast:
- Mohamad Imran Tapa
- Taniya Khan
- Ali Mohammad Dar
- Owaise Qayoom Bhat
- Burhan Qadfir
- Afrooza Langoo
text.release: The film premiered at the 2008 Venice Film Festival.
text.reception:
The film has a 77% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Scott Tobias of The A.V. Club graded the film a C+. Bill Weber of Slant Magazine awarded the film two and a half stars out of four.
The Hollywood Reporter gave the film a positive review and wrote, "Rough hewn neo-realist drama from India has its sociological fascinations."
